svg.title: Specialized Courier Hourly Pay Lanes
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-specialized-courier-pay-lanes; chapter number: 4; title: Specialized Courier Hourly Pay Lanes; subtitle: The biggest jump comes from cutting out the middleman; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: $15 to $65+ per hour; buckets: label: Pharmacy fleet hourly route; low: 15; high: 18; notes: Unposted stat orders paying $80-$100 each can stack on top (Boss up with Kae).; label: Employee medical courier listing; low: 17; high: 17; notes: Pass unless the company vehicle is needed to get started (Ello Hunny Bun).; label: Platform-based gig; low: 18; high: 28; notes: Middleman platform rate (MONEY CENTRAL).; label: Direct facility contract; low: 28; high: 65; notes: Hospital pays the courier directly; three or more contracts reach $5,000-$9,000 a month (MONEY CENTRAL).; caption: Same cooler, same specimens; the payer relationship decides which lane the hour lands in.; assumptions note: Direct facility pay is quoted as $28 to $65 an hour or more; STAT stacks only pay when the detour stays short, since a $50 STAT is not necessarily a $50 opportunity.; note: Sources - MONEY CENTRAL (GN6voRihdrc @ 00:03:18, 00:03:34); Boss up with Kae (rwv6d5iSQQY @ 00:06:04); Ello Hunny Bun (QxvapgKdXHI @ 00:08:14); Medical Courier Connection (qLWRmpKkEP0 @ 00:02:15).
